Real education changes how we treat people.

Heart health is the foundation of daily energy and longevity; mindful daily habits protect our cardiovascular vitality.

At Jalte Diye Foundation, our health education initiatives highlight practical everyday awareness for a healthy heart.

Take a 20-minute brisk walk and choose a nutritious, low-sodium meal today.
